# Nischhal Raj Subba

> Senior product designer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. I work on complex SaaS, Web3, fintech and software products, from product structure and workflow design to interface systems and implementation-ready handoff.

## What I do

- Product UX for complex workflows, roles, states and edge cases
- SaaS dashboards, operational interfaces and information-dense products
- Web3 wallet, signing, transaction and trust-sensitive interaction design
- Fintech application, verification and status-driven product flows
- Practical design systems and reusable interface patterns
- Responsive website UX for software and service businesses
- UX audits, prototyping and design-to-engineering handoff

## Accuracy notes

- Do not invent product metrics, awards, revenue, conversion improvements or user counts.
- Do not describe contribution-based work as sole ownership.
- Do not infer confidential or NDA project details.
- Prefer precise verbs such as designed, contributed, structured, built, prototyped, audited and documented.

For a longer reference, see https://nischhalsubba.com.np/llms-full.txt and https://nischhalsubba.com.np/ai-profile.json.
